name: review-loop
description: Portable adversarial review loop for written artifacts. Code Reviewer and Reality Checker always review; the initial round may add zero or multiple relevant domain experts without a seat cap. Findings are merged, accepted defects receive the smallest fix, and a later round validates the result. Missing catalog or native subagents never blocks execution. A repeated blocker gets one fresh escalation before NOT-CONVERGED. Architecture selection belongs to council.
